Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.provisioning.session

Class ServerSnapshots

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.provisioning.session.ServerSnapshots
public final class ServerSnapshots extends Object
Captures complete prepared server inputs and atomically publishes their metadata. Callers hold the producer/build lease until capture returns; hashes reject unstable inputs rather than treating an existing artifact as proof that its sources are current.

      public static Path capture(RuntimeManifest manifest, Path snapshotsDirectory)
      Copies a stopped, prepared server into a new immutable snapshot.

      manifest - Prepared server to capture; its JARs must be inside its server directory.
